answer: An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 16 epochs. Because the umber register is reconciled against the orchard funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the forge audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is inexpensive for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 16 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
